goal: decision-models S7 (application point A15; BR-DEC-6; recommendation (b) adopted 2026-11-02: issue_text is non-sensitive because the repository is public). A maintainer can measure offline how well a decision model triages issues as duplicate, needs_spec or ready_for_agent against the repository's own labels. Delegated choices: issue_text joins the non-sensitive input categories in scripts/decision-model/contract.ts; registry point a15_issue_triage; scripts/decision-eval/a15/extract.ts turns a saved gh issue list --state all --json number,title,body,labels,state,stateReason output into rows, pre-filling gold from labels (ready-for-agent to ready_for_agent, needs-spec to needs_spec, stateReason DUPLICATE to duplicate) with labeler repo-labels and leaving rows with none or conflicting signals unlabeled; scripts/decision-eval/a15/run.ts runs through the decision-eval harness with baseline majority_class.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/decision-eval-a15.test.ts, extract.ts on a fixture listing maps an issue labelled ready-for-agent to gold ready_for_agent, needs-spec to needs_spec, a closed issue with stateReason DUPLICATE to duplicate, and leaves an issue carrying both ready-for-agent and needs-spec, and one with no signal, unlabeled; re-extraction keeps a gold label a human changed.

In tests/decision-eval-a15.test.ts, run.ts with a bound provider whose egress lists nothing still sends issue_text (one fetch per labelled case through a recording fetch) and writes a report with the majority_class baseline and calibration; in tests/decision-model.test.ts a bindings egress entry listing issue_text is config_invalid as a non-sensitive category.
